configuration.title: Muninn for VS Code
configuration.editorAssociations.descrip: Automatically set workspace markdown files to open with Muninn's custom markdown editor.
configuration.integrations.mermaid.enabl: Enable inline Mermaid rendering inside the Muninn custom markdown editor.
configuration.integrations.mermaid.allow: Allow Mermaid rendering in restricted workspaces (disabled by default for safety).
configuration.toolbar.mode.description: Choose the Muninn toolbar mode. Basic shows core actions, advanced shows the full authoring toolbar.
configuration.appearance.contentWidth.de: Controls the document content column width. Comfortable uses 70ch, full uses the editor width, and numbers from 40 to 120 are treated as ch units.
configuration.images.destination.descrip: Folder for pasted, dropped, and picked image files, relative to the current Markdown document.

capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Reading uses URI-based providers; note and image creation require a writable file-system provider.
configuration.editorAssociations.depreca: No longer used. Choose Reopen Editor With → Configure default editor to set your Markdown editor. Muninn never changes workspace associations.
